name: @codeai-hub/kimi-module
description: Kimi provider integration for CodeAI Hub core

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node -e "const assert=require('node:assert/strict'); const fs=require('node:fs'); const os=require('node:os'); const path=require('node:path'); const kimi=require('./dist/index.js'); const {normalizeKimiWireEvent}=require('./dist/messaging/kimi-event-normalizer.js'); const {KimiWireRouter}=require('./dist/wire/kimi-wire-router.js'); const textEvents=normalizeKimiWireEvent({type:'ContentPart',payload:{type:'text',text:'visible reply'}}); assert.equal(textEvents[0].type,'assistant'); assert.equal(textEvents[0].content,'visible reply'); const thinkingEvents=normalizeKimiWireEvent({type:'ContentPart',payload:{type:'think',think:'internal thought'}}); assert.equal(thinkingEvents[0].type,'thinking'); assert.equal(thinkingEvents[0].content,'internal thought'); assert.equal(thinkingEvents[0].tag,'thinking'); const sent=[]; let malformed=null; const router=new KimiWireRouter({sendJson:(m)=>sent.push(m),onMalformedFrame:(line,error)=>{malformed={line,error};}}); const pending=router.request('initialize',{}); router.handleLine(JSON.stringify({jsonrpc:'2.0',id:1,result:{status:'ok'}})); router.handleLine('not-json'); const tempDir=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'kimi-provider-home-')); const providerHomePath=path.join(tempDir,'providers','kimi','home'); const workspacePath=path.join(tempDir,'workspace'); fs.mkdirSync(workspacePath,{recursive:true}); let metadata=null; const adapter=new kimi.KimiProviderAdapter({workspace:{workspacePath,providerHomePath,configPath:'/tmp/user-kimi/config.toml'},reporter:{info:(_message,nextMetadata)=>{metadata=nextMetadata;}}}); assert.equal(typeof adapter.subscribe,'function'); const unsubscribe=adapter.subscribe('smoke-session',()=>{}); assert.equal(typeof unsubscribe,'function'); unsubscribe(); Promise.all([pending,adapter.initialize()]).then(([result])=>{assert.deepEqual(result,{status:'ok'}); assert.equal(malformed.line,'not-json'); assert.equal(fs.statSync(providerHomePath).isDirectory(),true); assert.equal(metadata.providerHomePath,providerHomePath); assert.equal(metadata.userConfigPath,'/tmp/user-kimi/config.toml'); assert.deepEqual(metadata.cliArgs,['--config-file','/tmp/user-kimi/config.toml','--yolo','--work-dir',workspacePath]); fs.rmSync(tempDir,{force:true,recursive:true});}).catch((error)=>{fs.rmSync(tempDir,{force:true,recursive:true}); throw error;});"
